title: graykode/nlp-tutorial
summary: A comprehensive NLP tutorial repository for deep learning researchers, featuring Jupyter Notebook implementations of popular NLP models including Transformers, BERT, and attention mechanisms using both PyTorch and TensorFlow frameworks.
problem_solved: Bridges the gap between theoretical NLP/deep learning concepts and practical implementation for researchers and developers.
why_valuable: Provides well-documented, beginner-friendly code implementations of cutting-edge NLP models, making complex architectures accessible through hands-on learning.
